tables.server.label: Realm row (name, address, ports, time zone)
tables.server.why: Name, address, port, limit, order, enable and recommended: Operations -> Servers (validated like the server's RealmCatalogEntry; the login list is re-read at every login). Identifier and id stay fixed; calendar changes use audited revisions.

name.rule: 1..35 printable ASCII bytes; the server list has a 36-byte terminated name field.

ip_address.rule: IPv4 or DNS name, at most 23 ASCII bytes (RealmCatalogEntry.MaximumLegacyHostBytes); the address the client's game connection goes to.

enabled.rule: At least 1 and at most 16 enabled realms (RealmCatalogSnapshot.MaximumEntries); add realms disabled.

display_order.rule: 0 or more; order in the server list.

game_port.rule: 1..65535; a game process for this realm must listen there.

recommended.rule: At most one enabled realm is recommended.

time_zone_id.rule: IANA name recognized by host and PostgreSQL; next revision and trigger-generated audit required.
